podcast.body: Radiohead's debut album, released on February 22, 1993. The title was inspired by a segment from a Jerky Boys crank call tape, which an English group called Chapter House had given them. The band members, considering themselves "mama's boys," found the title "somehow an appropriate title." "Creep" was the lead single, "Anyone Can Play Guitar" was the second, and "Stop Whispering" was the third. The album received "OK press" but nothing "terribly spectacular." "Pablo Honey was, like I said, really on February 22nd, 1993."

podcast.body: This album was largely a "prefabricated discographic product" created by EMI, with the band lacking significant experience at the time to fully implement their own artistic vision. The band members "no tenían mucha experiencia, entonces como que no pudieron hacer todo lo que le subiese gustado."
